front: What happened to primary school fees in 1980?
back: They were abolished, and primary enrolment rose very quickly.

front: What did the Legal Age of Majority Act (1982) do?
back: It gave adult legal status at 18, including to women.

back: Rural clinics were built, village health workers trained and national immunisation started, so child health improved.

front: Why were the gains in social services not secure?
back: Quality problems, unemployment, ESAP fees and cuts, and HIV/AIDS strained the services in the 1990s.
